SITE INFORMATION

Website terms

13 October 2026

Using the portfolio

This website presents Laura Ortega’s services and selected work. You may browse it and contact Laura about a project. Project examples remain subject to the rights of their respective owners.

Prices and scope

Prices are starting points in USD. The final scope, fees, revisions, maintenance and deliverables are agreed in a separate project proposal. Sending a form does not create a contract or reserve a project slot.

Images and content

Some portfolio illustrations are generated using AI. Project preview images represent the referenced projects. Do not reuse the branding, illustrations or website content without permission from the relevant owner.

Third-party sites

External websites and services are managed by their own providers. Their availability and terms may change. For questions or an issue with this site, contact me@pancratzia.com.
